verdict.rationale: Honeybadger has its own natural-language features in two places. Natively, the "Describe your search" panel turns a plain-language description into an error search. Its official hosted MCP server, with OAuth, lets an AI assistant handle projects, errors, BadgerQL queries and dashboards from conversational requests. Broader natural-language operation, though, needs an external AI assistant as the client, and the built-in natural-language feature covers only search. missing for 10: native in-app natural-language control beyond search (e.g., resolving errors or configuring alerts by plain language), independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language accuracy.
